info.description: Local control API for recording, settings, and the library.

get.description: Remote panel. No access key required.

post.description: Starts the target already chosen on the desktop.
Ends the session and returns the saved path.

One host-pixel still of the virtual desktop, with monitor and window rectangles. Saving and copying stay in the browser.
Returns theme, language, save folder, and LAN status. The access key is empty.

patch.description: Updates theme, language, or save folder. The listen port cannot be changed.

get.description: Lists files in the save folder.
